title: a merge left unfinished is completed
line: a merge an older tool made of the 1940 household's daughter into its son left her card, which the rule had taken, naming her and her membership of the family beside his: a decision on that card is refused and says how to finish the merge; the merge run again re-points the card and folds the membership, and reconsider then judges the rule's decision against him and takes it back whole, his link with it

steps.say: the 1940 page arrives through the inbox: a card for each of the four it names
the rule takes the daughter's card
the daughter merged into the son as an older merge left it: her card still naming her, her membership of the family beside his

merge.note: harness: two children of one family merged, as one child entered twice under the same parents would be

steps.say: the owner's rejection of the card that names her is refused

has: is merged into Frederick Micheal Ahearn Jr

expect.why: a decision never lands on a merged person: the refusal names the merge that completes it

steps.say: the merge run again on the pair completes it
reconsider judges the rule's decision against the person its card names now

expect.why: the withdrawal takes back the link the decision wrote, on the person it moved to, as it takes back the card
